thread:
sam_oncall: ALERT: I think pages from prod-notify aren't reaching PagerDuty. incidentbot shows delivered but PD console empty. anyone? :rotating_light:
incidentbot: notification attempted -> notify-proxy (req=ab12cd34) status=200 queued_for_pd=true
sam_oncall: PD console shows no incident. logs say our proxy got 200 and pd_response=500 in body. two missed pages so far.
eng_sre_anna: copy. can you paste the raw proxy response for req=ab12cd34? headers/body?
sam_oncall: logs below:
```
2026-03-17T02:14:12Z req=ab12cd34 POST /webhook -> 200 OK
resp_body={"status":"ok","pd_enqueued":true}
pd_response=500 || "rate_limited"
```
eng_sre_anna: got it. looks like PD returned 5xx/429 to our downstream call; our notify-proxy marked as enqueued anyway. that double-faults with our fallback logic.
ops_lead_mike: customer impact? which customers/alarms missed?
sam_oncall: Acme Corp ticket says degraded inference routing for ~6 mins. EC2 alarms retriggered twice, no ack. marked sev3 by support.
customer_ops: confirming Acme saw 6m delay, submitted support ticket. assigned to support.
lucy_platform: mitigation proposal: flip notify-proxy to fallback PD key and restart, plus manually create PD incidents for missed alerts. steps:
 - kubectl set env deployment/notify-proxy USE_PD_FALLBACK=true -n infra
 - rollout restart deployment/notify-proxy -n infra
 - create manual PD incidents for missed alerts
eng_sre_anna: agree. also capture traces first:
```
curl -s 'https://notify-proxy.prod.internal/webhook/trace?req=ab12cd34'
kubectl logs deploy/notify-proxy -n infra --since=15m | grep ab12cd34
```
maria_dev: doing env flip now. `kubectl set env deploy/notify-proxy USE_PD_FALLBACK=true -n infra`
incidentbot: action=env_update user=maria_dev target=notify-proxy env[USE_PD_FALLBACK]=true
maria_dev: restarting to pick up env -> `kubectl rollout restart deployment/notify-proxy -n infra`
incidentbot: deploy_event -> rollout restarted (deployment/notify-proxy) by maria_dev
eng_sre_anna: while restart in flight, please manually page to cover missed alerts.
pagerduty-bot: Manually created incident PD-INC-982 for service "prod-notify" (external_id=PD-INC-982)
sam_oncall: manual page received by oncall. reassigning.
lucy_platform: after restart proxy logs show PD 202 responses from fallback key. looks healthy.
eng_sre_anna: root cause hypothesis: PagerDuty rate-limited our primary integration key; notify-proxy incorrectly treated downstream 5xx/429 as delivered, so fallback enqueuing didn't happen. we'll hotfix.
mike_ops: actions:
 - ENG: hotfix notify-proxy to treat non-2xx as undelivered and retry/fallback (ETA 2h)
 - SRE: run backfill / create manual incidents for any alerts lost (ETA 1h)
 - Support: notify affected customer and log timeline (ETA 30m)
eng_sre_anna: opened PR with change to treat PD 429/5xx as non-delivery and push to fallback queue: https://github.com/redwood/notify-proxy/pull/452
maria_dev: canarying hotfix now -> `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/notify-proxy notify-proxy=ghcr.io/redwood/notify-proxy:hotfix-452-canary`
incidentbot: deploy_event -> canary updated (notify-proxy) by maria_dev
sam_oncall: watching metrics. added temporary alert: notify.pd_retry_rate > 0 -> page #eng-sre for immediate attention.
eng_sre_anna: canary logs show two PD 429s then success after fallback key, added jitter/backoff in PR. will merge after 10m stable check.
lucy_platform: also adding circuit-breaker metric to prevent queue buildup if PD stays flaky.
customer_ops: Acme notified, they acknowledged follow-up and manual paging.
mike_ops: once PR merged we'll prod-roll and revert USE_PD_FALLBACK flag. keep this thread updated.
eng_sre_anna: merging now. prod rollout ETA ~20m.
sam_oncall: no further missed pages for 15m, mitigated (manual fallback used). keeping thread open for postmortem.
incidentbot: incident-thread updated -> status=mitigated by sam_oncall
eng_sre_anna: filing postmortem ticket PM-ISSUE-3341 with timeline, root cause, and actions (hotfix, metrics, fallback policy). assigning to eng/sre/platform.
maria_dev: FYI canary traces show transient PD 429s before fallback, added backoff jitter.
support: thanks all — closing live ops loop; will follow-up in postmortem for customer comms. :thumbsup:
